gloss: to aim for; to make sure of; to resolve

definitions.gloss: to aim for; to make sure of; to be determined to achieve
definitions.explanation: To set a goal such as accuracy, fairness, or success and resolve to achieve it. Used in formal speech and writing, above all in set phrases such as {万全|ばんぜん}を{期|き}する.

examples.japanese: ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する。
⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}して⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧にした。
examples.english: To be fair, we decided by lottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}す⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: To ensure accuracy, please check the figures once more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}して、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Determined to win the next tournament, he keeps practicing every day.

notes:
A formal verb, rare in conversation but common in announcements, business writing and news. The object is usually an abstract noun of quality: accuracy, fairness, safety, success. The older form {期|き}す is often used in the same phrases (⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}す⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する: to take every precaution, leave nothing to chance
- ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する: to ensure accuracy
- ⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する: to ensure fairness
- {必勝|ひっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する: to be determined to win
- {再起|さいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する: to resolve to make a comeback

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive
- Pattern: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}する
